we report the 1H, 15N and 13C backbone chemical shift assignments for CupS, a 159-residue protein from the cyanobacterium T. elongatus, including the side chain chemical shift of all but one amino acid residue, which is the C-terminal residue.
we have obtained a complete assignment of all 159 amino acids of CupS, which is a subunit with a molecular mass of 17.8 kDa.
